submittedArguments.prompt: Finished game-ready transparent sprite board, requested 1536x1024, exactly 4 columns x 3 rows of twelve DISTINCT turret render parts. Repaint all corresponding shapes in third image with high-detail Daoist Q hand-painted style from first two images: jade, ivory, warm gold, slate-blue metal, restrained cloud engraving and soft rounded material shading. Preserve each source region silhouette and holes, original relative proportions and north/up orientation. STRICT straight top-down orthographic, NO isometric angle, no structures or pads below weapons. Row1: cyclone main dark turret chassis with copper-gold segmented side armor and central straight rib, WITHOUT moving barrels; cyclone-barrel-1 SINGLE short rectangular grey cannon tube/metal barrel with dark left shading, no chassis; diffuse main V split chassis dark grey with coral-pink energy insets; diffuse-front-l SINGLE crooked left front arm in dark grey and coral-pink, no mirrored twin. Row2: disperse-blade-l SINGLE thin long left blade with ivory/light-blue diagonal bands, source asymmetric silhouette; disperse-mid tall slotted double-rail central spine with white-blue trim; disperse-side-l SINGLE angular dark grey side cover strip; duo small symmetrical copper-and-ivory circular/diamond rear housing WITHOUT its moving barrels, leave the pale interior docking region. Row3: duo-barrel-l SINGLE asymmetric copper cannon barrel, source wedge silhouette rising upper right, no separate twin; foreshadow large upright U-groove railgun dark graphite with gold/copper side channels, double prongs upward; fuse dark graphite three-paired purple-blue crystal chambers around central spine; hail small brown circular mortar housing with white ivory top insert and copper central pipe. Keep every component independent and complete, centered in equal grid cell with 13% empty margins. Thin warm gold accents and hand-painted shading must preserve mechanical identification. NO names/letters, NO grid, NO background, NO glow outside silhouette. Real alpha clear gaps. No whole turrets in cells requested as single detached parts.
